latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update www0 volume paths to www1 by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14462
* Unpin vite and rolldown now that rolldown 1.2.19 runs on older CPUs by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14433
* Run python_tests and javascript_tests on PRs to any branch by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14463
* python_tests: setup 18s → 6.5s, by caching Python and the dependencies by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14464
* Make tests independent of which tests ran before them by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14434
* python_tests: tests 66s → 40s on 2 xdist workers (whole job 97s → 61s with the stack) by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14465
* Automate Good First Issue assignment when a PR opens by @dhruvwarriorr in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14423
* Give Tasks projects a goal short of 100% by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14468
* Silence two pytest warnings in the Python test suite by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14467
* Add a Preview button to batch import rows with an archive.org, Amazon or Project Gutenberg ID by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14442
* Add saturation metrics: in-flight requests, event loop lag, thread pool, DB pool and memcache call time by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14469
* Require a passing code review to merge by @mekarpeles in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14455
* Code review: one team-keyed trigger path by @openlibrary-bot in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14475
* Make the code-review merge check reliable on every PR (#14476) by @openlibrary-bot in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14478
* Auto-request code-review team on fork PRs, not just same-repo (#14482) by @openlibrary-bot in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14483
* Let fork contributors re-run code review by commenting on their own PR by @openlibrary-bot in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14485
* Code review: post a real Approve/Request-changes verdict and resolve fixed threads (#14487) by @mekarpeles in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14489
* Make the code-review skip state-aware so a stale status can't strand a PR red (#14486) by @openlibrary-bot in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14488
* Keep shelf buttons working when search results include an edition with no work by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14473
* Add a Retry failed button to batch import pages by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14373
* Title batch import pages by batch number, with a breadcrumb back to all batches by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14497
* Delete spam lists on block and revert after the create-list action rename by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14499
* Remove slick-carousel by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14279
* Tell the review bot the codebase is Python 3.14 by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14505
* Post a pending code-review status when a review starts by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14507
* Run the code review when the re-request button is clicked by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14508
* Write a summary of each code review to its run page by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14509
* i18n: name placeholders and pluralise the Re-queued string by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14504
* Ask the code review bot for shorter comments by @RayBB in https://github.com
